notes: LT001 and LT002 independently reviewed the blinded candidate and reached the same conclusion. In the first review, the process was checked sequentially from specification understanding through state modeling, temporal rules, candidate properties, and final RTL. The candidate correctly accepts requests only while idle, ignores an acknowledgement sampled on the request-acceptance edge, loads the timeout counter to TIMEOUT_CYCLES, gives acknowledgement priority over timeout, ignores requests while busy without restart or replacement, and produces mutually exclusive registered one-cycle done and timeout pulses. In the second review, the edge numbering and boundary behavior were independently reconstructed. A request sampled on any busy edge, including a completion edge, has no causal effect on the outstanding transaction. S4.5 is therefore interpreted correctly as an ignored-request causal statement rather than a claim that unrelated ack, timeout, or countdown behavior freezes all state. No substantive process or RTL error was found. Trusted directed simulation and bounded formal verification pass all configured obligations.
